fuel_consumption.source_quote: Based on our expected fuel consumption in 2009, a one dollar increase in the price of crude oil will increase our annual fuel expense by approximately $41 million (implies ~1,722 million projected gallons for 2009).

instrument_type_details.notes: At Dec 31, 2008 (excluding Lehman contracts settled Jan 2009): WTI crude oil collars 14% of 2009 consumption (call $3.40/gal, put $2.53/gal); WTI crude oil call options 6% (at $2.54/gal); WTI crude oil swaps 3% (at $1.33/gal). Total maximum price hedge: 23%. Fair value net loss position $415 million (liability) due to sharp oil price decline. Required $171 million cash collateral posted. Lehman Brothers counterparty declared bankruptcy Sep 15, 2008; $125 million losses recognized in 2008 from these contracts.

warnings: Massive hedge liability of -$415M due to oil price collapse in late 2008. Lehman Brothers counterparty bankruptcy caused $125M loss; those contracts settled Jan 2009.
